gate.requirement: Shard boundaries derive only from frozen source structure + frozen inventory (no LLM, no token-only cuts)
gate.evidence: shard-planner.ts definitionUnits/structuralUnits/segmentUnits use the structural index and partitionSourceSlots; the packing never splits a unit; §20 test 'swapping every formula ... changes no boundary'
1.01: 380 units = 379 DEFINITION + 1 LEAD_IN; a 26,695-char definition stays one (oversized) shard

gate.requirement: Every material item has exactly one primary owner
gate.evidence: ownership proofs: 1.01 108/108, 6.08 278/278, 9.04 213/213, synthetic 400/400 - zero unowned, zero multiply owned

gate.requirement: Cross-shard dependencies are bounded read-only context with provenance; unresolvable => MISSING_CONTEXT
gate.evidence: ShardContextEntry carries kind/owner unit/owner shard/source span; rendered as READ-ONLY CROSS_REFERENCE_EXPANSION regions; unresolved entries recorded; §19 B tests

gate.requirement: Contextual copies earn no accountability credit
gate.evidence: stitcher strips lineage on unowned items (LINEAGE_CLAIM_ON_UNOWNED_ITEM), drops contextual emissions (never credited); §19 B 'if B's shard fails, B's items are MISSING even though A's shard saw B as context'

gate.requirement: Deterministic stitching with globally stable ids
gate.evidence: ids derive from owner unit + source-ordered ordinal; §10 tests: reversed emission order and a different packing yield identical rule ids

gate.requirement: Collisions explicit; no silent dedupe of incompatible semantics

gate.requirement: Global Pass C after stitching is the only completeness authority
gate.evidence: stitchShardResults runs reconcileInventoryWithComposition over the FULL frozen inventory; status derives from it

gate.requirement: Partial failure isolation: n-1 successes => PARTIAL/REVIEW_REQUIRED never COMPLETED; failed shard's items explicitly unresolved
gate.evidence: §19 E tests; unresolvedOwnedItems lists items of non-complete shards; failureReasons PROVIDER_FAILURE + SHARD_INCOMPLETE

gate.requirement: Bounded retry of only the failed shard by deterministic hash
gate.evidence: executeShardPlan reuses prior SHARD_COMPLETE results with equal shardHash; retries only SHARD_PROVIDER_FAILURE up to maxAttemptsPerShard; §19 F tests

gate.requirement: Shard freeze identity: a source change invalidates only the shards it touches; an inventory change invalidates all
gate.evidence: §19 G tests (definition 73 changed: only its owner shard and the shard reading it as context change hash; frozenContentHash change invalidates every shard)

gate.requirement: Zero-cost historical simulation preserves recorded nodes/values/rules/definitions/dependencies; any lineage loss is explicit and surfaces as MISSING, never false completeness
gate.evidence: 03: Chewy 6.08 - irNodes/rules/definitions/sharedCapacities/values/dependencyEdges preserved; lineageRefs 292->274 (18 minority claims on items owned by other shards stripped and recorded; 17/18 are owned by some shard and would be compiled by their owner in a real sharded run); Pass C after: represented 243 vs 253, materialMissing 22 vs 13, status REVIEW_REQUIRED (not COMPLETED); 6 holdout fixtures fully preserved; synthetic 400-def corpus fully preserved with identical dispositions
gate.caveat: a distribution simulation cannot show that the owner shards WOULD compile those 18 items - only a paid canary can (F-7B)

verdictRationale: All 12 gate points are met with zero-cost evidence. What remains unprovable without a model is whether a bounded shard compiles its owned items as faithfully as the recorded monolithic attempts did for small units; that is the F-7B canary question, not an architecture question. F7_CLOSED is not available by construction.
notActivated: executeShardPlan / planCompilationShards / stitchShardResults are exported but wired to no production path; compile.ts, caller.ts, prompt.ts, the tool protocol, Pass A, Pass C and the verifier are unchanged. No orchestration ran against Chewy.
